apiPainLevel.name: excruciating
apiPainLevel.description: The last block marks the threshold of pain under which most people would choose taking their own life immediately rather than standing it. This is obviously the case of severe heat and burning, which when makes the victims even jump buildings. Other conditions have also been associated with suicide by sufferers even after short episodes, such as cluster headaches (often described as one of the most painful conditions known to humans). The most gruesome forms of torture observed throughout human history have been designed to inflict pain at this level in the victims. Behavioral patterns associated with pain experiences in this categories include loud screaming, involuntary shaking and extreme restlessness and pacing. Another indicator is the expression of behaviors individuals would strongly refrain from displaying (e.g. for being dangerous or embarrassing) but that may relieve or simply expresses the pain. The assignment of conditions to this level must be therefore done cautiously and economically (self-reporting at this level ought to be evaluated with special care).

apiPainLevel.name: disabling
apiPainLevel.description: The division between the first two and the last two blocks marks a “disability threshold” that, if crossed, prevents most forms of functioning or enjoyment (socialization, sex, work, or most forms of entertainment) as the direct result of pain. Symptoms are continuously distressing. Individuals affected by the conditions in this category often substantially reduce their activity levels, may change eating patterns and often refrain from moving. Acute episodes of several diseases (e.g. severe pneumonia, some types of cancer), as well as hemorrhagic ulcers, strong migraines, food poisoning symptoms, acute postoperative pain and recent fractures in the acute inflammatory phase are in this category. Pain at this level disrupts or prevents sleeping. Only strong pain medications can relieve it.

apiPainLevel.name: hurtful
apiPainLevel.description: Pain experiences within this block include those that most would consider disruptive and disturbing. Although not entirely preventing individuals to function and conduct their usual daily activities, their ability to do so is impaired as the direct result of pain, and often associated with the desire to take painkillers or seek prompt treatment. Experiences in this category are associated with frequent complaints. The possibility to enjoy pleasant experiences is impaired, as is concentration and performance on mentally demanding tasks. Reduced alertness and attention to ongoing stimuli can be also present. Experiences in this category include stomach cramps, sinusitis and moderate headaches. The use of pain medications can relieve symptoms.

apiPainLevel.name: annoying
apiPainLevel.description: Pain experiences within this block represent nuisances, discomfort and experiences often classified as mild pain. Here, the pain experience is not intense enough to disrupt the routine or daily activities of individuals, their possibility to enjoy pleasant (positive) experiences, or their ability to conduct mentally demanding tasks that require concentration. Sufferers do not think about this sensation most of the time, and when they do they can adapt to it. In this category are often conditions such as mild itch, thermal discomfort, and mild musculoskeletal or joint pain.
